{{Top|leg}}
'''Carom''' was a game that [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] played in his youth. During the [[Battle of Bakura]], Solo used the game as inspiration for a [[Carom shot|tactic]] to bounce the ''[[Digit/Bakura V]]'' into the ''[[Dominant]]'' to open a hole in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] line.
